attributes.board_name: Mississippi State Department of Health, Professional Licensure (Speech-Language Pathologists and Audiologists)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs approved by ASHA (incl. state associations), AMA, accredited universities, Academy of Dispensing Audiologists, American Academy of Audiology, American Auditory Society, or SLP/audiology licensing boards of other states; 100% may be online/home study from these approvers; approved presentations (1 h + 1 h preparation, max 30%); graduate academic courses (1 semester hour = 15 clock hours); principal-author journal publications (max 30%). CPR, in-service and work-site orientation are not accepted.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensees first licensed during a licensing term accrue CE on a prorated scale; the Department notifies the required hours at licensure. Temporary licensees have the same CE requirement.
rules.audit_note: Certificates of attendance/completion (with source, hours and date) are submitted during the renewal period. Licensees short of hours receive a one-term CE probationary license; failing to make up the hours leads to revocation.
rules.notes: 20 contact hours = 2 CEUs (1 CEU = 10 contact hours) per licensing term; at least 50% (10 contact hours / 1 CEU) must be directly related to clinical practice of speech-language pathology or audiology. Licensure period July 1 - June 30; licenses expire June 30 of even-numbered years. Aides are registered, not licensed. No state-mandated topics.
rules.legal_basis: Miss. Code Ann. §73-38-33; 15 Miss. Admin. Code Pt. 19, Subpt. 60, Ch. 10, Rules 10.6.1, 10.7.2, 10.7.4
